description: Daily-only native instruction-count ceilings for tests/models/ara3d/ISSUE_129_N1540_17_EXE_MOD_448200_02_09_11SMC_IGC_V17.ifc, measured by scripts/perf-ratchet/measure-native-instructions.mjs --set large (scripts/perf/instructions.sh: perf_probe --single-thread under callgrind, feature phase-markers). Gates per-element kernel and parse work only; scheduling, threading and browser-only effects need an end-to-end A/B. Tolerance 0.05%: run-to-run variance is <=1e-6, the smallest change the ledger cares about is ~0.1-0.3%. Measured only by perf-ratchet-lower.yml (ISSUE_129 is ~2.5 min under callgrind); lookup is ~21k Ir and not ratcheted. Raising a ceiling is a human PR with a justification (docs/guide/performance.md, 'Perf ratchet ceilings'); lowering is the daily perf-ratchet-lower.yml job (Refs #6955).
